extraction_notes: The supplied four-page PDF identifies DO2301E-Q as a DOINGTER P-channel MOSFET in an SOT-23 package.
P-channel voltage and current quantities retain the negative signs printed in the datasheet; resistance and capacitance values are transcribed as positive SI quantities.

Typical Characteristics Figures 1, 2, 3, 4, and 6 on p. 3 were digitized from the plotted traces at visible grid locations; points are rounded compact readings and no unplotted points were invented or interpolated.
Both typical and maximum RDS(on) values are transcribed for both published VGS/ID conditions, preserving the table's source meaning and the pulse-test note.
The schema does not represent IDSS, IGSS, switching times, gate charges, absolute maximum ratings, or thermal resistance; those supplied table values were not forced into unrelated fields.
